objectives.title: Access Request Processing
objectives.description: Contractual writings address subject requests to access personal data.
criteria: Procedures confirming active personal data processing.
Clauses granting access to personal data undergoing processing.
Specifications stating processing purposes.
Documentation listing processed personal data categories.

objectives.title: Recipient Disclosure Transparency
objectives.description: Contractual terms document personal data recipients.
criteria: Listings identifying personal data recipients.
Specifications identifying recipient categories.
Identification of third-country destinations.
Identification of international entity recipients.

objectives.title: Retention Period Documentation
objectives.description: Contractual clauses specify personal data storage duration.
criteria: Stated personal data retention durations.
Established criteria fixing storage time limits when a fixed duration cannot be stated.

objectives.title: International Transfer Safeguards
objectives.description: Contractual clauses govern international transfer protection disclosures.
criteria: Disclosures detailing third country transfer safeguards.
Disclosures detailing international entity transfer safeguards.
Identification of the specific Article 46 transfer mechanism relied upon (e.g. standard contractual clauses, binding corporate rules).

objectives.title: Data Copy Delivery Terms
objectives.description: Contractual terms govern personal data copy provision and related safeguards.
criteria: Procedures delivering the initial personal data copy.
Administrative fees charged for supplementary copies.
Delivery utilizing commonly used electronic formats.
Safeguards ensuring copy provision does not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of other individuals.

objectives.title: Data Subject Rights Notice
objectives.description: Contractual writings address disclosure of related data subject rights within an access response.
criteria: Notice of the right to request rectification of personal data.
Notice of the right to request erasure of personal data or restriction of its processing.
Notice of the right to object to processing of personal data.
Notice of the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.

objectives.title: Data Source Disclosure
objectives.description: Contractual writings address disclosure of the origin of personal data not collected from the data subject.
criteria: Disclosure of the source of personal data when not collected directly from the data subject.
Identification of the specific source or category of source from which the personal data originated.

objectives.title: Automated Decision-Making Disclosure
objectives.description: Contractual writings address disclosure of automated decision-making and profiling in response to access requests.
criteria: Disclosure of the existence of automated decision-making, including profiling, referred to in Article 22(1) and (4).
Provision of meaningful information about the logic involved in such automated decision-making.
Disclosure of the significance of such processing for the data subject.
Disclosure of the envisaged consequences of such processing for the data subject.
